_meta.purpose: Target JSON shape for Claude-chat extraction output (A6.1). Not a strict machine-enforced JSON Schema — a shape description for the model and for validate_claude_extraction.py.

raw_table_rows: raw_table_row, ... - table rows copied before target mapping
missing: target_code, ... - codes from calculator_targets_compact.json with no PDF evidence
needs_review: found_item, ... - subset of found items flagged for human review (also present in found)

extraction_warnings: string, ... - free-text notes about the PDF that don't fit elsewhere (e.g. 'page 8 table overlaps a drawing, low confidence')

found_item_shape.target_code: string - matches a target/group code from calculator_targets_compact.json, or a free-text label if outside the compact list
found_item_shape.group_code: string|null - set only for items belonging to an extract_groups entry (e.g. trench_routes, foundation_rebar_items)
found_item_shape.item_name: string|null - for group items, e.g. route name 'К1' or rebar 'ф10 А500С'
found_item_shape.unit: string|null - unit as written in the PDF
found_item_shape.normalized_unit: string|null - from unit_normalization_guide.json; use 'mixed' only when group_code is set and the repeated row value has several fields with different units, never for scalar targets
found_item_shape.raw_text: string|null - verbatim quote or table cell description
found_item_shape.table_context: string|null - table title/header this value came from, if applicable
found_item_shape.candidates: array|null - present only when there is genuine ambiguity between two or more values; each candidate has the same shape as found_item minus this field

raw_table_row_shape.table_id: string|null - stable local id within this extraction, e.g. 'floor_slab_2_formwork_table'
columns: string, ... - column headers as visible in the PDF
raw_table_row_shape.row_index: number|null - row order inside the table
cells: string|number|null, ... - raw cell values in the same order as columns
raw_table_row_shape.raw_text: string|null - full raw row text if cells are hard to separate
raw_table_row_shape.unit: string|null - unit as written in the table row/cell
raw_table_row_shape.normalized_unit: string|null - from unit_normalization_guide.json; 'mixed' is allowed here when one raw table row contains several numeric cells in different units
mapped_target_codes: string, ... - target codes this row was mapped to, or empty if only kept for context

communications_pipe_items.name: string
communications_pipe_items.total_length_m: number|null - only if explicitly present in PDF

foundation_rebar_items.name: string
foundation_rebar_items.source_length_m: number|null - primary PDF quantity when row unit is м/п
foundation_rebar_items.kg_per_meter: number|null - from 'Масса ед. шт.' or kg/m column when present
foundation_rebar_items.weight_kg: number|null - only if PDF explicitly gives kg; do not calculate it

floor_slab_1_rebar_items.floor: number|null - should be 1 for this section

floor_slab_1_rebar_items.spec_length_m: number|null - primary PDF quantity when row unit is м/п
floor_slab_1_rebar_items.kg_per_meter: number|null - from 'Масса ед. шт.' or kg/m column when present; do not calculate total weight
floor_slab_1_rebar_items.rod_length_m: number|null - usually a catalog/standard rod length by diameter (e.g. 11.7 m), not a PDF quantity; only take from PDF if an explicit rod-length table is present, otherwise leave null for adapter/catalog fallback, do not invent
